prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A stylized legendary relic marker. Flat app-icon geometry. A diamond-
shaped talisman — an outer diamond outline with a smaller concentric
inner diamond, and at the very center a small bright luminous dot
(cyan, gold, or aurora-green palette color) suggesting a glowing
power core. All shapes are flat saturated palette colors with sharp
clean edges. Centered and symmetric.
formatted_prompt: Flat bold app icon centered on off-white canvas with generous padding. A symmetric diamond-shaped talisman rendered in pure flat vector geometry: a large bold outer diamond filled vivid red (#FF0000), a concentric inner diamond filled vivid blue (#0000FF) with sharp crisp edges, and at the absolute center a small circular dot filled bright yellow (#FFFF00) suggesting a luminous power core. All three shapes precisely centered and geometrically symmetric, each a distinct flat saturated fill with zero gradients, zero textures, zero brushwork. Black outline strokes define each boundary for maximum contrast. Clean 2026-era Material Symbols filled icon register, every element reading clearly at 16px.
